items.title: Calf Injuries: An Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport.
items.summary: This narrative review emphasizes an anatomy-based approach to calf injuries, advocating for precise characterization of myoconnective structures beyond muscle-based diagnosis. It highlights limited evidence linking anatomical patterns to prognosis and return-to-sport outcomes, favoring progressive, criteria-based loading and multifactorial return-to-sport decisions over fixed timelines or isolated imaging findings.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提示你，小腿肌肉损伤的诊断和管理应超越肌肉本身，转向更精确的肌腱-结缔组织结构特征。在制定康复和重返运动方案时，要以功能为主导，而非过分依赖影像学结果或固定时间表。
items.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学的诊断、管理与重返运动方法综述。
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述强调小腿损伤应采用基于解剖学的方法，倡导超越单纯肌肉诊断，精确描述肌腱-结缔组织结构。研究指出解剖模式与预后及重返运动结果相关的证据有限，倾向于采用渐进式、基于标准的负荷训练，并在多因素考量下决定重返运动，而非固定时间表或孤立的影像学发现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review suggests that diagnosis and management of calf muscle injuries should move beyond the muscle itself to more precise characterization of myoconnective structures. When designing rehabilitation and return-to-sport programs, prioritize function-led approaches over relying solely on imaging findings or fixed timelines.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，证据级别主要来自观察性研究，缺乏严格的系统评价和定量分析。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, with evidence primarily from observational studies, lacking rigorous systematic review and quantitative analysis.

items.title: Experiences of sexual rehabilitation post-stroke among LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the sexual rehabilitation experiences of LGBTQI+ stroke survivors (n=18) and their partners (n=5), revealing themes of sexuality being addressed or absent post-stroke, and negative interactions with health professionals. The findings suggest limited resources and a need for inclusive communication and training.
items.curatedReason: 本定性研究首次揭示 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣在性康复方面的独特经历和障碍，提示你和你的团队应采用更具包容性的沟通方式，并探索额外的培训，以更好地满足这类患者的需求。
items.titleZh: LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣在卒中后性康复方面的经历：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者（18 例）及其伴侣（5 例）在卒中后性康复方面的经历，揭示了性话题在康复中被提及或缺失，以及与医疗专业人员的负面互动等主题。研究提示资源有限，且需要更具包容性的沟通和培训。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study is the first to shed light on the unique experiences and barriers LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners face in sexual rehabilitation. It prompts you and your team to adopt more inclusive communication and explore additional training to better meet the needs of this patient population.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（18 名卒中幸存者，5 名伴侣），发现仅为特定人群的经验，结论外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (18 stroke survivors, 5 partners), providing insights only into specific experiences, thus limiting the generalizability of its conclusions.

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study among 269 stroke survivors in Ethiopia found a high prevalence of fall-related injury (79.9%, 95% CI: 75.1-84.4). Age > 65 (AOR=2.670), rural residence (AOR=2.352), and injury during walking and turning (AOR=2.960) were significant predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心研究揭示了埃塞俄比亚卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤的高负担，特别强调年龄、居住地和特定活动是预测因素，提醒你评估这些高风险因素以进行更有效的跌倒预防。
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤负担及其预测因素：一项多中心前瞻性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项对埃塞俄比亚 269 名卒中幸存者进行的多中心横断面研究发现，跌倒相关损伤的发生率高达 79.9%（95% CI: 75.1-84.4）。年龄 > 65 岁（AOR=2.670）、农村居住（AOR=2.352）以及在步行和转弯时受伤（AOR=2.960）是重要的预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study reveals a high burden of fall-related injuries among stroke survivors in Ethiopia, highlighting age, rural residence, and specific activities as predictors. This reminds you to assess these high-risk factors for more effective fall prevention.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，只能识别相关因素，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study uses a cross-sectional design, identifying associations but not establishing causality.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-total knee arthroplasty identified barriers (pain-triggered avoidance, fear, inadequate guidance, limited family support) and facilitators (perceived threat of poor prognosis, willpower, negotiation strategies) for home-based rehabilitation exercise decision-making. Findings suggest mitigating impulsive barriers and enhancing reflective engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究提示，老年全膝关节置换术后居家康复依从性不佳，部分是疼痛引发的本能回避和恐惧所致。你应在提供全面疼痛管理的同时，加强安全有效的关节活动度指导，以减少冲动性障碍，并通过个性化目标设定和积极的文化框架来增强患者的理性参与。
items.titleZh: 老年全膝关节置换术后居家康复锻炼决策的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 21 名老年全膝关节置换术后患者的定性研究，识别出居家康复锻炼决策的障碍（疼痛引发的规避、恐惧、指导不足、家庭支持有限）和促进因素（对不良预后的感知威胁、意志力、协商策略）。研究结果提示应减轻冲动性障碍并增强反射性参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study suggests that poor adherence to home-based rehab post-TKA in older adults is partly driven by pain-triggered avoidance and fear. You should address these impulsive barriers with comprehensive pain management and clear guidance on safe, effective ROM, while fostering reflective engagement through personalized goal-setting and a positive cultural framework.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（21 名老年患者），主要聚焦于中国三家三级医院的患者经历，研究发现的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (21 older adults) and focuses primarily on patient experiences from three tertiary hospitals in China, potentially limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: A narrative review of pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research (2021-2026) highlights its expanded scope beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, with evidence for alternative PR models and economic benefits. Challenges remain in access and maintaining benefits post-PR.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了 2021-2026 年肺康复研究的进展，坐实了肺康复的适用范围已远超稳定期 COPD，且新型递送模式具备经济效益。它提示你拓宽肺康复服务的适应症范围，并考虑多样化的递送模式以提高可及性。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点。
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于肺康复（PR）研究（2021-2026 年）的叙述性综述，强调其适用范围已从稳定期 COPD 扩展到多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，并有证据支持替代性 PR 模式和经济效益。但在提高可及性和维持 PR 后效益方面仍存在挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review summarizes pulmonary rehabilitation research from 2021-2026, confirming that PR's applicability extends far beyond stable COPD and that new delivery models are cost-effective. It prompts you to broaden the indications for PR services and consider diverse delivery models to improve accessibility.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，未进行系统性的文献质量评估和定量合成，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, lacking systematic quality assessment and quantitative synthesis, and may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: Short term effectiveness of dry needling and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization in knee osteoarthritis patients - a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) comparing dry needling (DN), instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM), and conventional treatment (CT) for knee osteoarthritis found all interventions effective. DN showed superior improvements in pain, function, and ROM, followed by IASTM and CT, with large effect sizes by week 4 and 6. All interventions had comparable effects on muscle strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，干针和器械辅助软组织松动术在改善膝关节骨关节炎的疼痛、功能和活动度方面优于传统治疗。干针效果最佳，但证据仍属短期小样本，可在临床上作为辅助手段，但不应作为核心干预。
items.titleZh: 干针与器械辅助软组织松动术对膝骨关节炎患者的短期疗效：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（34 例）比较了干针（DN）、器械辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）和传统治疗（CT）对膝骨关节炎的疗效，结果显示所有干预均有效。DN 在第 4 和第 6 周时在疼痛、功能和活动度方面表现出卓越的改善，其次是 IASTM 和 CT，效应量大。所有干预对肌肉力量的影响相当。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that dry needling and instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization are superior to conventional treatment in improving pain, function, and ROM in knee osteoarthritis. Dry needling was most effective, but the evidence is still short-term and small-sample, so it can be used as an adjunct in clinical practice but not as a core intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（34 名参与者），随访时间较短（6 周），且为单盲设计，可能存在安慰剂效应和偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (34 participants), short follow-up (6 weeks), and is single-blinded, which may introduce placebo effects and bias.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=75) on knee osteoarthritis patients compared passive blood flow restriction (BFR) at 50% and 70% limb occlusion pressure (LOP) with moderate-intensity resistance training (MI-RT). MI-RT yielded greater quadriceps strength. BFR-70% LOP significantly improved lower-extremity functional ability with less perceived exertion, while BFR-50% LOP showed smaller improvements.
items.curatedReason: 如果膝关节骨关节炎患者无法耐受常规中等强度阻力训练，那么 70% 肢体血流阻断压下的被动血流限制训练值得考虑。这项 RCT 表明，它能有效改善下肢功能，且患者感知劳累程度较低，优于 50% LOP，但对股四头肌力量的提升不如中等强度阻力训练。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者的血流限制联合不同负荷与中等强度阻力训练的比较：一项单盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对膝骨关节炎患者的单盲随机对照试验（75 例），比较了 50% 和 70% 肢体血流阻断压（LOP）下的被动血流限制（BFR）与中等强度阻力训练（MI-RT）。MI-RT 产生了更大的股四头肌力量增益。70% LOP 的 BFR 显著改善了下肢功能能力，且感知劳累较低，而 50% LOP 的 BFR 改善较小。
items.curatedReasonEn: Consider passive blood flow restriction at 70% limb occlusion pressure for knee OA patients who cannot tolerate conventional moderate-intensity resistance training. This RCT shows it significantly improves lower-extremity function with less perceived exertion, outperforming 50% LOP, though it yields less quadriceps strength gain than MI-RT.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，无法排除研究者偏倚对结果的影响，且未提供长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is single-blinded, so researcher bias cannot be excluded, and long-term follow-up data are not provided.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study (n=15,197) of knee/hip osteoarthritis patients receiving digital education and exercise therapy found the proportion meeting recommended physical activity (PA) levels increased from 51.4% to 58.5% at one year. Four PA trajectories were identified (persistently high 41.2%, persistently low 30.4%, increasing 16.5%, declining 11.9%), with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All trajectories showed comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项大样本纵向研究显示，数字化教育与运动疗法能有效提升膝/髋骨关节炎患者的体力活动水平，近六成患者达到或维持了推荐的活动量。这提示你，即使患者基线体力活动水平不高，这种干预模式也值得推荐，尤其要关注 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后体力活动轨迹：一项针对 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名膝/髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，接受数字化教育和运动疗法后，达到推荐体力活动（PA）水平的患者比例在一年内从 51.4% 增至 58.5%。研究识别出四种 PA 轨迹（持续高水平 41.2%，持续低水平 30.4%，增长型 16.5%，下降型 11.9%），其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局都有可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-sample longitudinal study shows that digital education and exercise therapy can effectively increase physical activity levels in knee/hip osteoarthritis patients, with nearly 60% reaching or maintaining recommended activity levels. This suggests that this intervention model is worthwhile, even for patients with low baseline physical activity, especially those with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 该研究基于注册数据，可能存在数据报告偏倚，且未提供关于干预具体内容和依从性的详细信息。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on registry data, which may involve reporting bias, and lacks detailed information on the specific intervention content and adherence.

items.title: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summary: This narrative review proposes a pathophysiology-informed framework for prioritizing exercise in frail older adults. It suggests tailoring interventions based on dominant physiological limitations (e.g., resistance training for weakness, aerobic training for dyspnea, balance training for gait instability), with multicomponent exercise as a default. Formal validation of this treatment-matching algorithm is needed.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了衰弱老年人康复中运动干预的病理生理学导向优先级框架。它提示你，在制定干预方案时，应根据患者最主要的生理储备限制（如肌力不足、呼吸困难或步态不稳）来调整运动类型，确保个性化治疗。
items.titleZh: 衰弱中的运动优先级：一项基于病理生理学的叙述性综述，旨在指导老年人康复。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述提出了一个基于病理生理学的框架，用于确定衰弱老年人运动的优先级。它建议根据主要的生理限制（例如，针对虚弱进行阻力训练，针对呼吸困难进行有氧训练，针对步态不稳进行平衡训练）来调整干预措施，并将多组分运动作为默认方案。该治疗匹配算法的正式验证仍是下一步研究方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review proposes a pathophysiology-informed prioritization framework for exercise interventions in frail older adults. It suggests that when designing intervention programs, you should tailor exercise types based on the patient's most dominant physiological reserve limitations (e.g., muscle weakness, breathlessness, or gait instability) to ensure personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，证据主要来自衰弱队列、肌少症试验及其他老年运动研究的推断，缺乏直接的瓶颈匹配处方对比试验，结论仍需正式验证。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review's evidence primarily extrapolates from frail cohorts, sarcopenia trials, and other older adult exercise studies, lacking direct trials of bottleneck-matched prescriptions, so conclusions require formal validation.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Physical and mental health outcomes of organized sports participation in adult women: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (16 studies, n=6,271 women) found that organized sports participation significantly improved VO₂peak (MD = 1.51), reduced depression (MD = -5.30), increased social capital (MD = +7.30), reduced fat mass (MD = -1.14 kg), and increased lean mass (MD = 0.90 kg) in adult women. Benefits extended to bone formation, occupational functioning, and social connectedness.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析坐实了参与有组织的体育运动能显著改善成年女性的体能、心理健康和生活质量，且其社会和结构维度放大了非结构性运动的益处。在推广女性健康和康复时，你应积极整合有组织的体育活动。
items.titleZh: 成年女性参与有组织的体育运动对身心健康的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（16 项研究，6,271 名女性）发现，成年女性参与有组织的体育运动显著改善了最大摄氧量（平均差 = 1.51），降低了抑郁（平均差 = -5.30），增加了社会资本（平均差 = +7.30），减少了脂肪量（平均差 = -1.14 公斤），并增加了瘦体重（平均差 = 0.90 公斤）。益处还扩展到骨骼形成、职业功能和社会联系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 6,271 women confirms that organized sports are a potent, multidimensional intervention for adult women's health. Not only does it significantly improve VO₂peak (MD = 1.51) and reduce depression (MD = -5.30), but its social and structural dimensions amplify benefits. You should actively recommend and integrate organized sports into women's health and rehabilitation promotion.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析纳入的 RCT 存在低至中度的内部效度风险，非随机设计存在高偏倚风险，这可能影响证据的整体强度。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis include RCTs with low to moderate risk of internal validity and non-randomized designs with high risk of bias, which may affect the overall strength of the evidence.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of cluster-set vs. traditional resistance exercise with equated total rest on muscular performance, perceived fatigue, and cardiovascular responses in resistance-trained women
items.summary: A crossover RCT (n=12 resistance-trained women) compared traditional set (TRS) with cluster set (CLS) resistance exercise (CLS10s, CLS30s intra-set rest) with equated total rest. CLS configurations (CLS30: 18.4 reps; CLS10: 15.8 reps) resulted in significantly more repetitions than TRS (12.8 reps, p < 0.0001) and lower perceived fatigue (CLS30: 4.08; CLS10: 5.25; TRS: 7.00, p = 0.0002). CLS also reduced fatigue/work and cardiovascular load/work ratios without altering post-set cardiovascular responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，在总休息时间相同的情况下，集束组训练能提高抗阻训练女性的肌肉耐力，并降低感知疲劳和心血管负荷。在设计女性抗阻训练计划时，可以考虑引入集束组配置，以提升训练效率和依从性。
items.titleZh: 集束组训练与传统抗阻训练在总休息时间相等的情况下对抗阻训练女性肌肉表现、感知疲劳和心血管反应的影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项交叉随机对照试验（12 名抗阻训练女性）比较了传统组（TRS）与集束组（CLS，组内休息 10 秒、30 秒）抗阻训练，总休息时间相同。CLS 配置（CLS30: 18.4 次；CLS10: 15.8 次）比 TRS（12.8 次，p < 0.0001）完成更多次数，且感知疲劳较低（CLS30: 4.08；CLS10: 5.25；TRS: 7.00，p = 0.0002）。CLS 还降低了疲劳/工作量和心血管负荷/工作量比值，而未改变训练后的心血管反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that, with equated total rest, cluster set training can improve muscular endurance and reduce perceived fatigue and cardiovascular load in resistance-trained women. When designing resistance training programs for women, consider incorporating cluster set configurations to enhance training efficiency and adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（12 名女性），且为急性效应研究，缺乏长期训练适应和效果的证据。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (12 women) and focuses on acute effects, lacking evidence for long-term training adaptations and outcomes.

items.title:
Physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy: a narrative review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A narrative review synthesized evidence on physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy (CP). It found reduced cardiorespiratory fitness, restrictive ventilatory patterns, high energetic demands for basic movements, and structural/metabolic alterations in skeletal muscle consistently constrain endurance capacity, with impairments more pronounced in those with greater functional limitations. Adapted training like Frame Running shows promise.
items.curatedReason: 这篇叙述性综述综合了脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素。它提示你，在评估和制定脑瘫儿童和成人的耐力训练方案时，需全面考虑其心肺、血液、肌肉骨骼等多个系统的整合性限制，并考虑采用 Frame Running 等适应性训练模式。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素：一项叙述性综述。
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述综合了脑瘫（CP）患者耐力能力的生理决定因素。研究发现，心肺适能下降、限制性通气模式、基本运动的高能量需求以及骨骼肌的结构/代谢改变持续限制着耐力能力，且功能受限越严重的个体损伤越显著。Frame Running 等适应性训练显示出前景。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review synthesizes the physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy. It suggests that when assessing and designing endurance training programs for children and adults with cerebral palsy, you need to consider integrated limitations across multiple systems, including cardiovascular, pulmonary, hematological, and musculoskeletal, and consider adaptive training modalities like Frame Running.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未进行系统性的文献质量评估和定量合成，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, lacking systematic quality assessment and quantitative synthesis, and may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: The effect of empowerment based on 5 A model on fall self-efficacy, self-care and quality of life in older adults: a parallel randomized clinical trial
items.summary: A parallel randomized clinical trial (n=110 older adults) found that a 12-week empowerment intervention based on the 5A model significantly improved fall self-efficacy (p < 0.001), self-care (p < 0.001), and quality of life (p < 0.001) in the intervention group compared to routine care. The mean age of participants was 68.28 ± 3.14 years.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，基于 5A 模型的赋能干预显著提升了老年人的跌倒自我效能、自我护理能力和生活质量。这提示你在制定老年跌倒预防和健康促进方案时，可以积极采用这种赋能模式。
items.titleZh: 基于 5A 模型的赋能干预对老年人跌倒自我效能、自我护理和生活质量的影响：一项平行随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项平行随机临床试验（110 名老年人）发现，与常规护理相比，基于 5A 模型的 12 周赋能干预显著改善了干预组的跌倒自我效能（p < 0.001）、自我护理（p < 0.001）和生活质量（p < 0.001）。参与者的平均年龄为 68.28 ± 3.14 岁。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that an empowerment intervention based on the 5A model significantly improved fall self-efficacy, self-care, and quality of life in older adults. This suggests you can actively adopt this empowerment model when developing fall prevention and health promotion programs for the elderly.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，结果在不同文化背景和医疗系统下的普适性可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center trial, and the generalizability of its findings to different cultural backgrounds and healthcare systems may require further validation.

items.title: Here are the Speech Language Therapy Coding Changes Going Into Effect on January 1, 2027
items.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, CPT code 92507 for speech language therapy will be deleted and replaced by ten new, more specific codes. These codes cover fluency, speech sound production, language comprehension and expression, and voice/upper airway/resonance disorders, with separate codes for initial 30 minutes and additional 15 minutes of direct patient contact.
items.curatedReason: CMS 将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日废除言语语言治疗代码 92507，并代之以十个更具体的新代码。这项更新直接影响美国言语语言治疗师的报销和执业，提醒你关注新的编码结构，以确保准确的计费。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的言语语言治疗编码变更细则。
items.summaryZh: 自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，言语语言治疗 CPT 代码 92507 将被删除，并由十个新的、更具体的代码取代。这些代码涵盖流利度、言语发音、语言理解和表达以及发声/上气道/共鸣障碍，并为初始 30 分钟和额外 15 分钟的直接患者接触提供单独的代码。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS will delete speech language therapy code 92507 and replace it with ten more specific new codes effective January 1, 2027. This update directly impacts reimbursement and practice for speech-language pathologists in the US, reminding you to pay attention to the new coding structure for accurate billing.

items.title: A 10-week randomized controlled hip-strengthening intervention in healthy, well-trained runners: longitudinal and cross-sectional analyses of frontal-plane running biomechanics across running speeds
items.summary: A 10-week RCT (n=48) in healthy, trained runners found that a hip-strengthening intervention improved hip abductor strength (0.20–0.29 Nm/kg) but did not alter frontal-plane running biomechanics (e.g., knee abduction moments). Greater hip abductor strength was associated with higher knee abduction moments only at slow running speeds at baseline.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对健康训练有素的跑者进行 10 周的臀部肌力强化，尽管能提高肌力，但并未显著改变跑步时的额状面生物力学。在制定跑步损伤预防方案时，不要高估臀部肌力训练对额状面生物力学的直接影响。
items.titleZh: 对健康、训练有素的跑者进行 10 周随机对照髋部强化干预：不同跑步速度下额状面跑步生物力学的纵向和横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康、训练有素跑者的 10 周随机对照试验（48 例）发现，髋部强化干预提高了髋外展肌力量（0.20–0.29 Nm/kg），但并未改变额状面跑步生物力学（如膝关节外展力矩）。基线时，只有在慢速跑步时，较高的髋外展肌力量才与较高的膝关节外展力矩相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that 10 weeks of hip strengthening in healthy, well-trained runners, despite improving strength, did not significantly alter frontal-plane running biomechanics. When developing running injury prevention programs, do not overstate the direct impact of hip strengthening on frontal-plane biomechanics.
items.limitation: 本研究仅针对健康、训练有素的跑者，结果可能不适用于存在跑步相关损伤或体能水平较低的人群。
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on healthy, well-trained runners, so the results may not be applicable to individuals with running-related injuries or lower fitness levels.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summary: An exploratory study (n=8 chronic stroke survivors) using directional EMG mapping found that severely impaired participants exhibited restricted upper-limb force generation in lateral directions and narrow medial activation tuning, correlated with larger angular errors. Force demands and task direction modulated these deficits, suggesting patient-specific vulnerable zones and enhanced shoulder-driven control strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究通过定向肌电图揭示了卒中后上肢力量控制的损伤相关性改变，尤其在重度受损患者中存在方向性限制和代偿策略。这提示你在设计个性化康复干预时，应考虑患者特定的“脆弱区域”和力/方向的复杂交互作用。
items.titleZh: 定向肌电图模式揭示卒中后上肢力量控制的损伤相关性破坏。
items.summaryZh: 一项使用定向肌电图映射的探索性研究（8 名慢性卒中幸存者）发现，重度受损的参与者在侧向力产生和内侧激活调谐方面表现出受限，这与更大的角度误差相关。力的需求和任务方向调节了这些缺陷，提示存在患者特定的脆弱区域和增强的肩驱动控制策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study, using directional EMG, reveals impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke, particularly directional limitations and compensatory strategies in severely impaired individuals. This suggests that when designing personalized rehabilitation interventions, you should consider patient-specific "vulnerable zones" and the complex interplay of force and direction.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（8 名慢性卒中幸存者），且缺乏对照组，无法确立干预措施的有效性，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (8 chronic stroke survivors) and lacks a control group, making it unable to establish intervention efficacy and limiting generalizability.

items.title: Relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified 63 sources on relaxation interventions in neurological rehabilitation, most frequently studied in multiple sclerosis and stroke. Interventions were generally feasible and well-accepted, with outcomes primarily assessed at the body structure and function domain, particularly psychological functioning.
items.curatedReason: 在神经康复中，放松干预确实可行且患者接受度高，尤其对于多发性硬化和卒中患者。根据这篇有 63 项来源的范围综述，你可以在评估这类患者心理功能的同时，考虑将放松疗法纳入其康复方案。
items.titleZh: 神经康复中的放松干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别了 63 篇关于神经康复中放松干预的文献，主要集中在多发性硬化和卒中患者。这些干预通常可行且接受度高，结局主要在身体结构和功能域（特别是心理功能）进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: Relaxation interventions are indeed feasible and well-accepted in neurorehabilitation, especially for individuals with multiple sclerosis and stroke. Based on this 63-source scoping review, you should consider incorporating relaxation therapies into your rehabilitation plans for these patients, particularly when assessing psychological functioning.
items.limitation: 本综述识别出证据异质性高，且研究主要集中于身心功能层面，缺乏对活动和参与等更广阔结局的评估。
items.limitationEn: This review identified high heterogeneity in evidence, with studies primarily focusing on body structure and function, and limited assessment of broader outcomes like activity and participation.

items.title: Exercise interventions for gait and balance performances among older adults with sarcopenic obesity: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (13 studies, n=502) on exercise interventions for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity found exercise training (power, resistance, multicomponent) improved gait speed, step length, functional mobility, static balance, and postural control, with mild adverse effects. Most studies (nearly 70%) were on older women, limiting generalizability to older men.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，运动训练对肌少性肥胖老年人的步态和平衡表现有潜在益处。在为这类患者设计康复方案时，可优先考虑力量训练、有氧训练及多组分训练，但需注意现有研究多集中于老年女性，对老年男性的普适性仍待进一步证实。
items.titleZh: 肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡表现的运动干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡运动干预的范围综述（13 项研究，502 例）发现，运动训练（力量、阻力、多组分）改善了步态速度、步长、功能活动度、静态平衡和姿势控制，且不良反应轻微。大多数研究（近 70%）针对老年女性，限制了结果对老年男性的普适性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates potential benefits of exercise training for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity. When designing rehabilitation programs for this population, prioritize power, resistance, and multicomponent training, but be aware that current research primarily focuses on older women, and generalizability to older men needs further confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，纳入的 13 项研究中近 70% 仅针对老年女性，因此结果对老年男性的普适性存疑。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review includes 13 studies, nearly 70% of which focused solely on older women, raising questions about the generalizability of the findings to older men.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Effect of mesenchymal stem cell-Derived secretome injection on functional outcomes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction using peroneus longus tendon autograft: a double-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A double-blind RCT (n=24) comparing ACL reconstruction with peroneus longus tendon autograft with or without mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived secretome injection found the secretome group had significantly higher IKDC (86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01) and Tegner–Lysholm scores (87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01) at six months post-op. No major adverse events were reported.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，在 ACL 重建手术中辅助注射 MSC 衍生的分泌组可提高 6 个月后的患者报告膝关节功能评分。尽管结果积极，但样本量小，且仅为短期功能结局，尚不能将其作为常规临床实践，应等待更大样本和长期随访的研究结果。
items.titleZh: 间充质干细胞分泌组注射对腓骨长肌腱自体移植物前交叉韧带重建术后功能结局的影响：一项双盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验（24 例）比较了采用腓骨长肌腱自体移植物进行前交叉韧带（ACL）重建术后是否辅助注射间充质干细胞（MSC）分泌组。结果显示，分泌组在术后 6 个月时 IKDC 评分（86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01）和 Tegner–Lysholm 评分（87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01）显著更高。未报告主要不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample RCT suggests that adjunctive injection of MSC-derived secretome during ACL reconstruction may improve patient-reported knee function scores at 6 months. While positive, the small sample size and short-term functional outcomes mean it cannot be adopted as routine clinical practice yet; larger trials with long-term follow-up are needed.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量非常小（24 名参与者），随访期仅为 6 个月，且关注的是患者报告结局而非生物学愈合指标，结果的长期有效性和生物学机制仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: This study has a very small sample size (24 participants) and a follow-up period of only 6 months. It focuses on patient-reported outcomes rather than biological healing markers, so the long-term efficacy and biological mechanisms require further investigation.

items.title: Paired cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes across repeated anodal transcranial direct current stimulation in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory within-subject study
items.summary: An exploratory within-subject study (n=14 Parkinson's disease patients) found that five consecutive daily sessions of anodal transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) were accompanied by significant within-participant decreases in UPDRS-III (p=0.035) and NMSS-K (p < 0.001), and increases in MoCA-K (p=0.011). CSF metabolomic changes included increased purine-related and tyrosine/levodopa-related metabolites and altered non-polar lipids. The study lacked a sham control.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究发现，重复经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）可引起帕金森病患者脑脊液代谢组学和临床症状的短期变化。尽管提示 tDCS 可能的生物学效应，但由于缺乏假对照组，你不能将此结果视为确切的治疗证据，仍需等待随机对照试验。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病重复阳极经颅直流电刺激后的配对脑脊液代谢组学变化：一项探索性受试者内研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性受试者内研究（14 名帕金森病患者）发现，连续五天的阳极经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）伴随受试者内 UPDRS-III（p=0.035）和 NMSS-K（p < 0.001）的显著下降，以及 MoCA-K（p=0.011）的显著增加。脑脊液代谢组学变化包括嘌呤相关和酪氨酸/左旋多巴相关代谢物增加，以及非极性脂质改变。本研究缺乏假对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study found that repeated transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) may induce short-term changes in cerebrospinal fluid metabolomics and clinical symptoms in Parkinson's disease patients. While suggesting potential biological effects of tDCS, due to the lack of a sham control group, you should not consider these results as definitive treatment evidence and must await randomized controlled trials.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（14 名帕金森病患者），且缺乏假对照组，无法确立干预措施的有效性或 tDCS 特异性因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (14 Parkinson's disease patients) and lacks a sham control group, thus unable to establish intervention efficacy or tDCS-specific causality.

items.title: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (21 studies) mapped evidence on whole-body vibration (WBV) and lumbar stabilization exercises (LSE) for postural control in flexible flatfoot (FF). It found very limited direct evidence for WBV or LSE specifically in FF, with most insights derived from related populations. The effectiveness and safety of these interventions in FF remain uncertain, highlighting a need for RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者步态控制的证据极为有限，现有证据多来自相关人群。在临床实践中，若无针对柔性扁平足的直接 RCT 证据，应谨慎应用这些干预措施。
items.titleZh: 全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者姿势控制的影响：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述（21 项研究）梳理了全身振动（WBV）和腰部稳定训练（LSE）对柔性扁平足（FF）患者姿势控制的证据。研究发现，针对 FF 的 WBV 或 LSE 直接证据非常有限，多数见解来自相关人群。这些干预措施在 FF 患者中的有效性和安全性仍不确定，亟需随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates extremely limited evidence for whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises improving postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot, with most existing evidence from related populations. In clinical practice, apply these interventions cautiously without direct RCT evidence for flexible flatfoot.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，主要旨在识别研究空白，而非评估干预措施的有效性，且纳入的大多数证据来自与柔性扁平足相关的其他人群。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review primarily aims to identify research gaps rather than evaluate intervention effectiveness, and most included evidence is from populations related to flexible flatfoot.

items.title: Cryoneurolysis as an effective spasticity treatment option : a case series
items.summary: A case series of eight patients with neuropathic gait or lower extremity pain, weakness, and spasticity found that cryoneurolysis of certain nerves provided immediate benefits lasting a few months to one year. The authors conclude that cryoneurolysis can be a safe and efficient treatment option for spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 这组病例报告显示冷冻神经松解术可有效治疗痉挛，且效果持续数月至一年。虽然这提供了新的治疗可能性，但病例报告证据级别较低，不应将其作为常规方案，而应视为探索性辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 冷冻神经松解术作为一种有效的痉挛治疗选择：一个病例系列。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8 名神经性步态或下肢疼痛、无力及痉挛患者的病例系列研究发现，对特定神经进行冷冻神经松解术可提供即时益处，持续数月至一年。作者得出结论，冷冻神经松解术可以作为一种安全有效的痉挛治疗选择。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series indicates that cryoneurolysis can effectively treat spasticity, with effects lasting several months to a year. While it offers a new treatment possibility, case reports are low-level evidence and should not be considered a routine intervention, but rather an exploratory adjunct.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，样本量极小（8 例），且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然病程影响，证据级别低。
items.limitationEn: This is a case series with an extremely small sample size (8 cases) and no control group, making it impossible to rule out placebo effects or natural disease progression, thus representing low-level evidence.

items.title: A Return to Performance Continuum for Football (Soccer) Players After ACL Reconstruction: Bridging Rehabilitation, Return to Play and Sustained Performance.
items.summary: A paper outlines a staged Return to Performance continuum for football players after ACL reconstruction, bridging rehabilitation and sustained performance. It emphasizes restoring movement quality, progressive football-specific technical/tactical retraining, physical reconditioning, and maximal strength restoration.
items.curatedReason: 这篇共识论文提出了 ACL 重建术后足球运动员重返运动和持续表现的连续体框架，弥补了传统康复与高水平竞技表现之间的鸿沟。它为你在 ACLR 患者管理中提供了更细致的分期和评估指标，特别是针对竞技运动员。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后足球运动员重返表现连续体：连接康复、重返赛场和持续表现。
items.summaryZh: 一篇论文概述了 ACL 重建术后足球运动员重返表现的阶段性连续体，旨在连接康复与持续表现。它强调恢复运动质量、循序渐进的足球专项技术和战术再训练、体能再调节以及最大力量恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus paper proposes a continuum framework for return to performance and sustained performance in football players after ACL reconstruction, bridging the gap between traditional rehabilitation and high-level athletic demands. It offers you more detailed staging and evaluation metrics for managing ACLR patients, especially competitive athletes.
items.limitation: 该文章为专家意见和共识，而非基于随机对照试验的证据。
items.limitationEn: This article represents expert opinion and consensus, rather than evidence based on randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that 45% were adherent to home-based exercise therapy. Higher pre-cLBP physical activity and lower cLBP intensity were associated with better adherence, but supervision did not significantly influence it.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，慢性非特异性腰痛患者居家运动治疗依从性不足一半（45%），且监督形式对依从性影响不显著。这表明了当前居家方案的局限性，促使你重新审视患者筛选和依从性支持策略。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：一项针对 491 名 ComPaRE cLBP 电子队列参与者的横断面研究 (ADHERE II)。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 491 名慢性非特异性腰痛成人患者的横断面研究发现，居家运动治疗依从性为 45%。较高的腰痛前身体活动水平和较低的腰痛强度与更好的依从性相关，但监督形式对其影响不显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that home-based exercise therapy adherence in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain is less than half (45%), and supervision methods do not significantly influence adherence. This highlights the limitations of current home-based programs and prompts you to reassess patient selection and adherence support strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且依从性数据基于患者自评量表。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality, and adherence data is based on self-reported questionnaires.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Validity and Reliability of Accelerometers to Evaluate Preschool-Aged Children’s Physical Activity and Sedentary Behavior During Free-Living Condition: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review assesses the validity and reliability of accelerometers in evaluating physical activity and sedentary behavior among preschool-aged children during free-living conditions.
items.curatedReason: 评估学龄前儿童身体活动和久坐行为时，加速计确实是一种有潜力的工具。然而，这篇系统综述告诉你，你需要充分理解其有效性和可靠性的局限性，以确保在儿童康复和发育评估中选择合适的测量方法。
items.titleZh: 加速计评估学龄前儿童自由生活条件下身体活动和久坐行为的有效性和可靠性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述评估了加速计在评估学龄前儿童自由生活条件下身体活动和久坐行为方面的有效性和可靠性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Accelerometers are indeed a promising tool for evaluating physical activity and sedentary behavior in preschool-aged children. However, this systematic review tells you that you need to fully understand the limitations of their validity and reliability to ensure you select appropriate measurement methods for pediatric rehabilitation and developmental assessment.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: This article provides an appraisal of a clinical practice guideline focused on the physical therapy management of children diagnosed with developmental coordination disorder.
items.curatedReason: 这篇关于发育性协调障碍儿童物理治疗管理临床实践指南的评估，直接关联到儿童康复的临床决策。它能帮助你了解现有指南的质量和推荐，从而优化你对这类患儿的干预方案。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 本文评估了一项关于发育性协调障碍儿童物理治疗管理的临床实践指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This appraisal of a clinical practice guideline for physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder directly informs you about the quality and recommendations of existing guidelines, making your intervention decisions more evidence-based. You should definitely use this appraisal to review your current clinical decisions for these children.

items.title: Hockey players who wont play through concussions
items.summary: An athlete recounts experiencing concussion symptoms after a hockey hit, describing memory loss and the subsequent adherence to a sports medicine clinic's recovery protocol and school-mandated exertion symptom reporting.
items.curatedReason: 虽然只是个案分享，但这篇 BJSM 博客文章提供了一个运动员在脑震荡后依从康复方案的真实经历。你可以用它来和患者进行教育或共情沟通，它也提醒我们关注年轻运动员的症状管理和康复心理，尤其是在记忆力受损的情况下。
items.titleZh: 不再带着脑震荡上场的曲棍球运动员
items.summaryZh: 一名运动员回忆了在曲棍球比赛中头部撞击后出现脑震荡症状的经历，包括失忆，以及随后如何遵守运动医学诊所的康复方案和学校规定的劳累后症状报告要求。
items.curatedReasonEn: Though just an individual account, this BJSM blog post offers a real-world example of an athlete adhering to a concussion recovery protocol. You can use it for patient education or empathetic communication, and it reminds us to focus on symptom management and the psychological aspects of recovery for young athletes, especially when memory loss is involved.

items.title: The effects of route previewing on adaptive gait and gaze behaviour under cognitive dual-task conditions in older adults
items.summary: This study found that cognitive dual-tasking increased stepping errors and reduced stride length, but route previewing significantly mitigated these negative effects on adaptive gait and gaze behavior. Previewing prior to gait initiation helped participants look further ahead and make fewer irrelevant fixations, improving walking safety under cognitive load.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，对于老年人，在认知双任务条件下，路线预判可以显著减轻自适应步态和注视行为的负面影响，减少步态错误和交叉步。这提示你在对老年患者进行步态训练时，可以纳入预判策略，通过支持视觉运动规划来提高其在复杂环境中的行走安全性。
items.titleZh: 认知双任务条件下路线预判对老年人适应性步态和注视行为的即时影响。
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，认知双任务处理会增加步态错误并缩短步幅，但路线预判能显著减轻这些负面影响，改善适应性步态和注视行为。在步态启动前进行预判有助于参与者看得更远并减少无关注视，从而提高认知负荷下的行走安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that route previewing significantly mitigates the negative effects of cognitive dual-tasking on adaptive gait and gaze behavior in older adults, reducing stepping errors and cross-steps. This suggests that when conducting gait training for older patients, you can incorporate previewing strategies to enhance their walking safety in complex environments by supporting visual-motor planning.
items.limitation: 研究样本量适中（社区老年人），且在受控实验室环境下进行，结果的外推性到真实复杂环境可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a moderate sample size (community-dwelling older adults) and was conducted in a controlled laboratory setting, potentially limiting the generalizability of the findings to real-world complex environments.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: This study co-designed pain neuroscience education (PNE) material for adolescents with low back pain (LBP). Four focus groups with 15 participants initially, and one more with 6, guided the development of the "Back To Move" prototype, emphasizing back-specific, practical, trustworthy, and engaging content.
items.curatedReason: 本研究通过与青少年共同设计，成功开发了青少年下腰痛PNE教育材料。其设计原则是提升青少年对疼痛教育的接受度，将背痛特定信息、实用工具和易于查找的格式相结合。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动；共同设计青少年下腰痛疼痛神经科学教育：焦点小组洞见。
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过与患有下腰痛的青少年共同设计，开发了疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）材料。基于与15名和6名青少年参与者的焦点小组讨论，最终的“Back To Move”原型强调了提供与背痛相关、实用、可信且吸引人的内容的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study successfully co-designed PNE educational material for adolescents with low back pain. The design principles emphasize making pain education more acceptable to adolescents by combining back-specific information, practical tools, and an easy-to-find format.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Physical therapy care utilization and associated sociodemographic and clinical factors among noncommunicable diseases in the brazilian population: A cross-sectional, population-based study.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 88,531 Brazilians with noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) found stroke had the highest physical therapy utilization (17.0%). Follow-up by a healthcare professional was a common associated factor across NCDs, with pharmacotherapy, age ≥60 years, and severe activity limitation also significant for specific conditions.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对88,531名巴西NCD患者的研究提示，卒中患者物理治疗利用率最高（17.0%）。对所有NCD患者而言，定期随访、药物治疗、年龄≥60岁及严重活动受限，均与物理治疗利用率相关，你在推广服务时应优先关注这些群体。
items.titleZh: 巴西人口非传染性疾病患者物理治疗利用率及其社会人口学和临床相关因素：一项基于人群的横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项针对88,531名巴西非传染性疾病（NCDs）患者的横断面研究显示，卒中患者的物理治疗利用率最高（17.0%）。医疗专业人员的随访是所有NCDs患者物理治疗利用的共同相关因素，特定疾病还与药物治疗、年龄≥60岁和严重活动受限有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study of 88,531 Brazilian NCD patients suggests that stroke patients have the highest physical therapy utilization (17.0%). For all NCD patients, regular follow-up, pharmacotherapy, age ≥60 years, and severe activity limitation are associated with physical therapy utilization, so prioritize these groups when promoting services.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且数据来自2019年调查，可能无法反映最新情况。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and data from a 2019 survey may not reflect current conditions.

items.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A 3-week randomized clinical trial (N=96) found both blood flow restriction (BFR) walking and low-load resistance training with BFR (LL-BFR) significantly improved lower limb motor function (FMA-LE: +1.66 to +2.25 points) and balance in stroke patients compared to control, with 34.4% of LL-BFR participants achieving MCID vs. 15.6% in control. No serious adverse events occurred.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT证实，对于卒中患者，为期3周的血流限制（BFR）步行或低负荷阻力训练结合BFR，比传统训练更能改善下肢运动功能和平衡。FMA-LE得分平均改善1.66至2.25分，且未报告严重不良事件。尽管平均改善幅度适中，但更多患者可获得临床有意义的改善，这表明BFR作为卒中康复的辅助手段值得考虑，并可能提升患者功能预后。
items.titleZh: 血流限制训练对卒中患者下肢运动功能和平衡的影响：一项随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项为期3周的随机临床试验（N=96）发现，血流限制（BFR）步行和结合BFR的低负荷阻力训练（LL-BFR）均显著改善了卒中患者的下肢运动功能（FMA-LE：+1.66至+2.25分）和平衡，优于对照组。LL-BFR组有34.4%的患者达到临床最小重要差异（MCID），而对照组为15.6%。未发生严重不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that 3 weeks of blood flow restriction (BFR) walking or low-load resistance training with BFR significantly improves lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients compared to conventional training, with average FMA-LE improvements of 1.66 to 2.25 points and no serious adverse events. While the average improvement is modest, a greater number of patients may achieve clinically meaningful improvement, indicating BFR warrants consideration as an adjunctive stroke rehabilitation modality and potentially improves functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间较短（3周），样本量适中，BFR的长期疗效和普适性尚需更大规模、更长时间的RCT验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up (3 weeks) and moderate sample size; long-term efficacy and generalizability of BFR require larger, longer-term RCTs.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored barriers to community-based fall prevention exercise programs for 11 adults aged 50+ with self-reported mobility or sensory impairments. Four themes emerged, highlighting multidimensional accessibility challenges, stigma, program misalignment, and self-stereotyping. Co-designing inclusive, flexible, and identity-affirming programs is suggested.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了老年人跌倒预防锻炼项目在招募和参与上面临的多维度障碍，特别是对残疾老年群体。发现污名化、项目不匹配和自我刻板印象是主要障碍。这提示你需要重新思考跌倒预防项目的推广和设计，通过共同设计策略，打造更具包容性和身份认同感的项目。
items.titleZh: “这不适合我”：针对“渐进性残疾”老年人的社区跌倒预防运动项目。
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了11名50岁以上自报有行动或感觉障碍的成年人参与社区跌倒预防运动项目的障碍。研究归纳出四个主题，强调了多维度可及性挑战、污名化、项目不匹配和自我刻板印象。研究建议共同设计包容、灵活且身份认同的方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals multidimensional barriers to recruitment and participation in fall prevention exercise programs for older adults, particularly those with disabilities. Stigma, program misalignment, and self-stereotyping were identified as major deterrents. This suggests you need to rethink the promotion and design of fall prevention programs, using co-design strategies to create more inclusive and identity-affirming initiatives.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（11名参与者），且依赖参与者的自我报告，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (11 participants) and relies on self-reported data, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.summary: This proof-of-principle study introduced ScoreE, an isokinetic dynamometry metric, to objectively quantify post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance in 35 patients. ScoreE demonstrated good to excellent inter-rater (ICC 0.81-0.89) and test-retest reliability (ICC 0.76-0.93), with moderate associations with Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS) grades, providing a reliable tool for longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提出了一种新的等速测力学指标ScoreE，用于客观量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。该指标具有良好的评定者间和重测信度（ICC范围0.76-0.93），且与MAS量表评分中度相关。ScoreE为客观监测卒中痉挛和评估干预效果提供了一个有潜力的工具，有助于你更精准地评估患者进展。
items.titleZh: 一种量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗的常模扭矩-轮廓方法：一项概念验证研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究引入了等速测力学指标ScoreE，以客观量化35名卒中患者的肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。ScoreE表现出良好至卓越的评定者间（ICC 0.81-0.89）和重测信度（ICC 0.76-0.93），并与改良Ashworth量表（MAS）评分呈中度相关，为长期监测提供了一个可靠工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE, a novel isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric for objectively quantifying post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. The metric demonstrates good to excellent inter-rater and test-retest reliability (ICC range 0.76-0.93) and moderate associations with MAS grades. ScoreE offers a promising tool for objectively monitoring stroke spasticity and evaluating intervention effects, helping you more precisely assess patient progress.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（35名卒中患者），且对振动干预后的反应性评估为探索性，未进行正式评估，需更大规模研究验证其临床敏感性和响应性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (35 stroke patients), and the responsiveness to vibration intervention was exploratory without formal assessment, requiring larger studies to validate clinical sensitivity and responsiveness.

items.title: Identifying Indicators of Advanced Levels of Clinical Competence in Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy: A Francophone Delphi Study
items.summary: A Francophone Delphi study identified 13 indicators of advanced clinical competence in musculoskeletal physiotherapy among 27 experts. Key indicators reflected advanced clinical reasoning, such as real-time adaptation, hypothesis prioritization, and decision-making under uncertainty. Only one outcome indicator (clinical performance weighted by case complexity) reached consensus, suggesting a focus on managing complexity.
items.curatedReason: 这项Delphi研究明确了骨骼肌肉物理治疗的13项高级临床能力指标，其中最重要的是不确定性下的决策、假设优先级排序和实时调整。这提示我们在培养和评估高级PT时，应着重提升复杂病例的临床推理能力，而非仅仅关注标准化结果。
items.titleZh: 识别骨骼肌肉物理治疗高级临床能力的指标：一项法语区Delphi研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项法语区Delphi研究在27位专家中识别出骨骼肌肉物理治疗高级临床能力的13个指标。关键指标反映了高级临床推理能力，如实时适应、假设优先级排序和不确定性决策。仅一项结果指标（按病例复杂性加权的临床表现）达成共识，表明应侧重于复杂性管理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Delphi study identified 13 key indicators for advanced clinical competence in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, primarily focusing on advanced clinical reasoning rather than standardized outcomes. This suggests that when evaluating and developing advanced PTs, you should prioritize decision-making under uncertainty, hypothesis prioritization, and error management, thereby refining talent development and assessment systems.
items.limitation: 本研究为Delphi专家共识，结果可能受专家组构成和地域限制（仅限法语区）影响，且缺乏实际临床验证。
items.limitationEn: This Delphi expert consensus study may be influenced by the composition and geographical limitations (Francophone only) of the expert panel, and lacks practical clinical validation.

items.title: Immediate effects of suspension walker support on locomotor behavior of pre-walking infants with Down syndrome
items.summary: This study investigated the immediate effects of suspension walkers on locomotor behavior in pre-walking infants with Down syndrome (DS, aged 10-19 months). Walkers robustly increased upright time, stepping rate, and overall locomotor activity. Caregivers initiated most walker movement, which correlated with increased infant stepping, suggesting potential for home-based intervention.
items.curatedReason: 悬吊式助行器能即时、显著地提高10-19个月大、未会走路的唐氏综合征婴儿的直立时间、步速和整体运动量。你可以考虑将这种助行器作为家庭早期干预工具，指导家长在日常生活中辅助婴儿迈步，从而促进其运动发展。
items.titleZh: 悬吊式助行器支撑对未会走路唐氏综合征婴儿运动行为的即时影响。
items.summaryZh: 这项研究调查了悬吊式助行器对未会走路的唐氏综合征（DS，10-19个月大）婴儿运动行为的即时影响。助行器显著增加了直立时间、步进率和整体运动活动。大多数助行器运动由照护者启动，且与婴儿步进增加相关，提示其在家庭干预中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Suspension walkers immediately and significantly increase upright time, stepping rate, and overall locomotor activity in pre-walking infants with Down syndrome (10-19 months). You can consider using these walkers as a home-based early intervention tool, guiding caregivers to assist infants with stepping in daily life to promote motor development.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且关注的是即时效应，缺乏长期随访来评估助行器对运动发展里程碑的持续影响。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size and focused on immediate effects, lacking long-term follow-up to assess the sustained impact of walkers on motor development milestones.

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored South African physiotherapists' experiences with self-management for chronic non-specific low back pain (CNLBP). Six themes emerged, emphasizing the biopsychosocial model, patient beliefs, social factors, and interprofessional care as crucial for effective self-management.
items.curatedReason: 在低收入非洲环境中，生物心理社会模型对CNLBP患者的自我管理至关重要。作为物理治疗师，在南非这样的社会文化背景下，你需要考虑患者的信念、社会因素及跨专业协作，而非仅仅提供标准化方案。
items.titleZh: 南非物理治疗师关于非特异性慢性下腰痛患者自我管理实践的经验：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了南非物理治疗师在慢性非特异性下腰痛（CNLBP）患者自我管理方面的经验。研究归纳出六个主题，强调了生物心理社会模型、患者信念、社会因素和跨专业协作对于有效自我管理的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The biopsychosocial model is crucial for self-management in CNLBP patients, especially in low-income African settings. As a physiotherapist, in socio-cultural contexts like South Africa, you must consider patient beliefs, social factors, and interprofessional collaboration, rather than simply providing standardized protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量有限且仅限于南非林波波省，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a limited sample size and was confined to Limpopo province, South Africa, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Sleep under fire: towards a tripartite circadian-neuroendocrine framework for conflict-zone athletes
items.summary: This editorial proposes the Tripartite Athletic Stress Framework (TASF) to address the under-represented physiological burden of armed conflict on athletes. The model integrates conflict-induced chronic psychological stress, sleep impairments, and neuroendocrine dysregulation, outlining priorities for monitoring and intervention in conflict-zone athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论提出了一项三方运动员应激框架（Tripartite Athletic Stress Framework, TASF），旨在整合武装冲突对运动员的复合生理负担，并强调了睡眠、昼夜节律和神经内分泌轴的重要性。这为你理解和管理冲突区运动员的恢复提供了新的视角，提醒你在康复计划中更全面地考虑这些高压因素。
items.titleZh: 战火中的睡眠：迈向冲突区运动员的三方昼夜节律-神经内分泌框架。
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论提出了“三方运动员应激框架”（TASF），旨在解决武装冲突对运动员未被充分认识的生理负担。该模型整合了冲突引起的慢性心理应激、睡眠障碍和神经内分泌失调，并为冲突区运动员的监测和干预提供了优先事项。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial proposes a Tripartite Athletic Stress Framework (TASF) to integrate the complex physiological burden of armed conflict on athletes, emphasizing the importance of sleep, circadian rhythms, and the neuroendocrine axis. This offers you a new perspective on understanding and managing recovery for athletes in conflict zones, reminding you to comprehensively consider these high-stress factors in rehabilitation plans.

items.title: Strengthening participatory approaches to improve brain health research and policy in elite football
items.summary: The inaugural Head Injuries in Football Conference in Zurich on May 27–28, 2025, gathered professionals from elite football, including physicians from various clubs and national teams, to discuss sport-related concussion decisions.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论总结了首届足球脑损伤会议的见解，强调了在精英足球中加强参与式方法以改进脑健康研究和政策的重要性。了解这些多学科交流有助于你掌握运动性脑震荡管理的最新理念和实践动态。
items.titleZh: 加强参与式方法以改善精英足球中的脑健康研究和政策。
items.summaryZh: 首届足球脑损伤会议强调了在精英足球中加强参与式方法以改进脑健康研究和政策的重要性，会议汇集了多学科专家讨论运动性脑震荡管理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary summarizes insights from the inaugural Head Injuries in Football Conference, emphasizing the importance of strengthening participatory approaches to improve brain health research and policy in elite football. Understanding these multidisciplinary exchanges can help you grasp the latest ideas and practical developments in sports concussion management.

items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: A case series of 100 patients undergoing QT-ACLR showed that early isometric quadriceps LSI at 3 months (β = 3.9; adjusted R² = 0.36; P < .03) and isokinetic quadriceps strength at 9 months (β = 3.9-4.7; adjusted R² = 0.34-0.35; P ≤ .003) were independently associated with higher 2-year IKDC and Lysholm scores.
items.curatedReason: 股四头肌肌力 LSI 指标在四头肌腱自体移植物 ACLR 术后 3-9 个月，能够预测 2 年患者报告结局，提示早期股四头肌力量恢复的重要性。康复训练中应持续关注并测量股四头肌的对称性指数，尤其在早期阶段。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌腱自体移植物 ACL 重建术后早期肢体对称性指数与 2 年患者报告结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对 100 名接受股四头肌腱自体移植物 ACL 重建术患者的病例系列研究显示，3 个月时的早期等长股四头肌肢体对称性指数（β = 3.9; Adj R² = 0.36; P < .03）和 9 个月时的等速股四头肌肌力（β = 3.9-4.7; Adj R² = 0.34-0.35; P ≤ .003）与 2 年 IKDC 和 Lysholm 评分独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Quadriceps strength LSI scores at 3-9 months post-QT-ACLR predicted 2-year patient-reported outcomes, emphasizing the importance of early quadriceps strength recovery. Continue to monitor and measure quadriceps LSI, especially in the early phases of rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，证据等级为 4 级，且为单中心数据，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This case series study (Level 4 evidence) from a single center has limited generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=75) found that both high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) and extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises (UNGE) improved nerve conduction and upper-limb function more than UNGE alone in post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. HILT produced significantly greater improvements than ESWT in electrophysiological outcomes and DASH scores, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up (all P < .001).
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光治疗（HILT）联合尺神经滑行训练在烧伤后肘管综合征中的电生理和功能改善优于体外冲击波（ESWT）或单独滑行训练。这意味着在处理此类神经卡压时，HILT 可能是更有效的理疗选择，未来可考虑纳入临床路径。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光治疗与体外冲击波治疗对电生理和功能反应的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 75 名烧伤后肘管综合征患者的随机对照试验发现，高强度激光治疗（HILT）和体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）联合尺神经滑行训练（UNGE）在改善神经传导和上肢功能方面均优于单独 UNGE。HILT 在电生理指标和 DASH 评分上均表现出比 ESWT 更显著的改善，且益处在 12 周随访中得以维持（所有 P < .001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises demonstrated superior electrophysiological and functional improvements in post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome compared to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) or gliding exercises alone. This suggests HILT may be a more effective modality for this type of nerve entrapment, warranting consideration in clinical pathways.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（每组 25 人），随访期为 12 周，长期效果尚需更多证据确认。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small (25 participants per group), and the 12-week follow-up period means long-term effects require further confirmation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
