items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 97 adolescent patients found that ACL-RSI scores ≥59.2 were associated with a 3.56 times increased likelihood of successful return to sport (78.3% overall) after patellar stabilization surgery, independently of sex, procedure type, or injury characteristics.
items.curatedReason: ACL-RSI 量表（即便不是针对髌骨不稳设计）在髌骨稳定术后预测青少年重返运动方面显示出价值，提示心理准备度在重返运动决策中的重要性。评估时，在传统功能指标之外，记得纳入心理准备度评估。
items.titleZh: 青少年髌骨稳定手术后心理准备度能否预测成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 97 名青少年髌骨稳定手术患者进行的回顾性队列研究发现，ACL-RSI 评分 ≥59.2 与成功重返运动的可能性增加 3.56 倍相关（总成功率 78.3%），且独立于性别、手术类型或损伤特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ACL-RSI scale, even though not designed for patellofemoral instability, shows value in predicting return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescents. This highlights the importance of psychological readiness in return-to-sport decisions. Incorporate psychological readiness assessments alongside traditional functional metrics.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且为单中心数据，可能存在选择偏倚和结果推断的局限性。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study from a single institution, which may introduce selection bias and limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Effectiveness of office-based vergence/accommodative therapy with movement for accommodative dysfunction in concussion-related convergence insufficiency: a secondary analysis of the CONCUSS randomised clinical trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of the CONCUSS RCT found that 12 sessions of immediate office-based vergence/accommodative therapy with movement (OBVAM) and home reinforcement remediated 86% of accommodative dysfunction in concussion-related convergence insufficiency, compared to 28% in the watchful waiting group.
items.curatedReason: 针对脑震荡相关的集合不足引起的调节功能障碍，办公室动眼/调节疗法（OBVAM）显示出高效率。在评估脑震荡患者时，务必筛查集合不足及相关调节功能障碍，并考虑将 OBVAM 作为一线干预。
items.titleZh: 脑震荡相关集合不足引起的调节功能障碍：CONCUSS 随机临床试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 对 CONCUSS 随机临床试验的二次分析发现，对于脑震荡相关集合不足引起的调节功能障碍，立即进行 12 次办公室动眼/调节疗法（OBVAM）并辅以家庭强化，可使 86% 的调节功能障碍得到改善，而观察等待组的改善率为 28%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Office-based vergence/accommodative therapy with movement (OBVAM) demonstrates high efficacy for accommodative dysfunction related to concussion-induced convergence insufficiency. When evaluating concussion patients, be sure to screen for convergence insufficiency and related accommodative dysfunction, and consider OBVAM as a first-line intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为随机临床试验的二次分析，可能存在一些原始研究未报告的局限性；且只关注了调节功能障碍这一特定视功能障碍。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of a randomized clinical trial, which may have some limitations not reported in the original study; it also focuses only on accommodative dysfunction as a specific visual impairment.

items.title: Efficacy and evidence certainty of traditional Chinese exercises for musculoskeletal disorders: an umbrella review of meta-analyses
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesizing 547 unique associations from meta-analyses established high-certainty evidence for traditional Chinese exercises (TCEs), especially Tai Chi, in improving physical function in knee osteoarthritis, mental health in neck pain, and sleep quality in fibromyalgia. Optimal benefits were achieved with sustained interventions of ≥6 months duration, ≥3 times/week frequency, and ≥150 min weekly volume.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型伞形综述确立了传统中式锻炼（特别是太极）对骨关节炎、颈痛和纤维肌痛等肌肉骨骼疾病具有高确定性的益处。在处理慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者时，尤其在患者有文化接受度的情况下，应积极推荐并指导长期、高频率的中式锻炼。
items.titleZh: 传统中式锻炼治疗肌肉骨骼疾病的疗效和证据确定性：一项伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 547 项关联的荟萃分析伞形综述，确立了传统中式锻炼（特别是太极）在改善膝骨关节炎的身体功能、颈痛的精神健康和纤维肌痛的睡眠质量方面具有高确定性证据。最佳临床益处通过持续 ≥6 个月、频率 ≥3 次/周、每周总量 ≥150 分钟的干预实现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large umbrella review establishes high-certainty evidence for the efficacy of traditional Chinese exercises (especially Tai Chi) in musculoskeletal disorders like knee osteoarthritis, neck pain, and fibromyalgia. Actively recommend and guide long-duration, high-frequency Chinese exercises for chronic musculoskeletal pain patients, particularly when culturally appropriate.
items.limitation: 综述纳入研究的质量存在异质性，且部分结局的证据确定性仍为中低，提示具体干预细节和长期效果需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The quality of studies included in the review is heterogeneous, and the certainty of evidence for some outcomes remains moderate to low, suggesting that specific intervention details and long-term effects require further research.

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Austria explored physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access, revealing perceived readiness for triage roles despite lacking a legal framework, moderate-to-high confidence in differential diagnosis but lower in red-flag screening, and identified needs for targeted training and interprofessional collaboration.
items.curatedReason: 在奥地利这样的转诊制国家，物理治疗师普遍认为自己有能力提供直接评估和治疗，但仍需正式的法律框架和红旗征象筛查的培训。这提示直接准入在全球推行时，除了临床技能，配套的法律、责任和跨专业协作机制也是关键。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊制下物理治疗师对直接准入的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在奥地利进行的定性研究探讨了物理治疗师对直接准入的看法。结果显示，物理治疗师普遍认为自己已在非正式地进行直接准入的初级评估工作，但在鉴别诊断方面信心较高，在红旗征象筛查方面信心较低。研究强调了正式培训、跨专业合作和报销机制对于安全公平实施直接准入的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: In referral-based systems like Austria, physiotherapists feel competent for direct access but need formal legal frameworks and red-flag screening training. This highlights that successful global direct access implementation requires not just clinical skills, but also supportive legal, liability, and interprofessional collaboration mechanisms.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小（10 名物理治疗师），结果可能不完全代表整个行业或推及其他地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative exploratory study with a small sample size (10 physiotherapists), so the findings may not be fully representative of the profession or generalizable to other geographic regions.

items.title: Post-concussion screen time duration and type and its association with symptom resolution in youth aged 11-17 years
items.summary: A cohort study in youth (11-17 years old) found that optimal median screen time of 141 min/day during the first 3 days post-concussion was associated with a 1.35-fold higher rate of symptom resolution compared to 260 min/day. Those with 120-240 min/day of screen time had 2.27-fold faster symptom resolution than those with <120 min/day and 1.58-fold faster resolution than those with >240 min/day.
items.curatedReason: 青少年脑震荡后屏幕使用时间与症状缓解之间的关系并非越少越好。中度屏幕使用（每日 120-240 分钟）可能有助于症状更快解决，这提示 PT 在给出屏幕使用建议时应更具弹性，而非一刀切地禁止。
items.titleZh: 青少年脑震荡后屏幕使用时长和类型及其与症状缓解的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 11-17 岁青少年的队列研究发现，脑震荡后前 3 天的最佳中位屏幕使用时间为每日 141 分钟，与每日 260 分钟相比，症状缓解率高出 1.35 倍。每日屏幕使用时间在 120-240 分钟的青少年，症状缓解速度比 <120 分钟/天快 2.27 倍，比 >240 分钟/天快 1.58 倍。
items.curatedReasonEn: The relationship between screen time and symptom resolution after concussion in youth is not simply a "less is more" scenario. Moderate screen use (120-240 minutes per day) may be associated with faster symptom resolution, suggesting that PTs should offer more nuanced advice on screen time rather than a blanket ban.
items.limitation: 这是一项队列研究，无法确立因果关系；此外，结果可能受到混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a cohort study, which cannot establish causality. Furthermore, the findings may be influenced by confounding factors.

items.title: Over-the-counter analgesics improve postconcussion symptoms and recovery: findings from the Concussion Assessment, Research and Education (CARE) Consortium
items.summary: A cohort study from the CARE Consortium found that concussion patients using OTC analgesics had a 24.5% higher rate of return to unrestricted play and 30.3% lower SCAT-3 symptom scores compared to non-users. Early use was associated with a 35.6% higher rate of return to unrestricted play.
items.curatedReason: 这项队列研究提示，脑震荡后使用非处方止痛药（OTC analgesics）可能与更高的重返无限制运动率和更低的症状严重程度相关。这意味着在脑震荡管理中，可以考虑在适当情况下指导患者使用 OTC 止痛药。
items.titleZh: 非处方止痛药改善脑震荡症状和恢复：来自 CONCUSSION 评估、研究和教育（CARE）联盟的发现
items.summaryZh: 来自 CARE 联盟的一项队列研究发现，脑震荡患者使用非处方止痛药的重返无限制运动率高出 24.5%，SCAT-3 症状评分低 30.3%。早期使用与重返无限制运动率高出 35.6% 相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cohort study suggests that using over-the-counter (OTC) analgesics after concussion may be associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play and lower symptom severity. This implies that guiding patients on appropriate OTC analgesic use can be considered in concussion management.
items.limitation: 本研究为队列研究，只能揭示相关性，不能确立因果关系；且未详细报告止痛药具体剂量和持续时间。
items.limitationEn: This cohort study can only show correlation, not causation, and does not report specific analgesic dosages or durations.

items.title: Effect of Integrated Respiratory and Functional Training on Weaning from Mechanical Ventilation, Respiratory and Peripheral Muscle Strength, Functional Ability, and Pain After Emergency Abdominal Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: An RCT on emergency abdominal surgery (EAS) patients showed that integrated respiratory and functional training improved weaning from mechanical ventilation, respiratory and peripheral muscle strength, functional ability, and pain.
items.curatedReason: 紧急腹部手术后，整合呼吸与功能训练对脱机、呼吸肌/外周肌力、功能能力及疼痛有积极作用。这提示 PT 早期介入对 EAS 患者的预后至关重要，应将这类整合训练纳入 ICU 和术后康复方案。
items.titleZh: 整合呼吸与功能训练对紧急腹部手术后脱机、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力和疼痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对紧急腹部手术（EAS）患者的随机对照试验显示，整合呼吸与功能训练改善了机械通气脱机、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力以及疼痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrated respiratory and functional training positively impacts weaning from mechanical ventilation, respiratory and peripheral muscle strength, functional ability, and pain after emergency abdominal surgery. This highlights the crucial role of early PT intervention for EAS patients, suggesting such integrated training be incorporated into ICU and postoperative rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 原始研究细节未在摘要中给出，无法评估确切样本量、干预细节和结局指标的长期随访，可能限制结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: Specific details of the original study are not provided in the abstract, preventing evaluation of precise sample size, intervention specifics, and long-term follow-up of outcomes, which may limit the generalizability of conclusions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: From rehabilitation to performance: reframing vestibular-ocular interventions to optimise sports performance
items.summary: This editorial argues for reframing vestibular-ocular interventions, such as the Vestibular Ocular Motor Screen (VOMS), from solely concussion management to also optimizing sports performance by enhancing the integration of vision, balance, proprioception, and motor response.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章指出，评估脑震荡的眼庭系统干预（VOMS）可以扩展到优化运动员表现。在康复后期和表现训练中，可以考虑将 VOMS 作为提升视觉、平衡和本体感觉整合的工具。
items.titleZh: 从康复到表现：重新审视前庭眼部干预以优化运动表现
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章提出，应重新审视前庭眼部干预（如前庭眼动筛查 VOMS）的作用，不仅用于脑震荡管理，还应扩展到通过增强视觉、平衡、本体感觉和运动反应的整合，从而优化运动表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests that vestibular-ocular system interventions (VOMS), used for concussion assessment, can be extended to optimize athletic performance. In later stages of rehabilitation and performance training, consider using VOMS as a tool to enhance the integration of vision, balance, and proprioception.

items.title: Percutaneous Electrolysis for the Management of Musculoskeletal Disorders. A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found very low-certainty evidence that adding percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) to therapeutic exercise (TE) was not superior to sham or TE alone for pain or function in tendinopathies. Low-certainty evidence showed PNE plus TE provided greater short- to medium-term pain reduction compared to dry needling plus TE in tendinopathies, but no significant differences in myofascial pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 很遗憾，肌腱病变患者的经皮电解治疗（PNE）联合运动治疗，其优于假治疗或单独运动治疗的证据质量极低，别抱太大期望。PNE 结合运动治疗与干针结合运动治疗相比，可能在短期至中期带来更好的止痛效果，但证据可靠性不高。
items.titleZh: 经皮电解治疗肌肉骨骼疾病：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，在肌腱病变中，经皮电解（PNE）联合运动治疗（TE）在短期、中期或长期随访中，疼痛或功能方面不优于假PNE或TE单独治疗（证据确定性极低）。在肌腱病变中，PNE联合TE比干针（DN）联合TE在短期和中期疼痛缓解方面更优（证据确定性低），但在功能上无优越性。在肌筋膜疼痛综合征中，PNE与DN在疼痛或功能上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Unfortunately, for tendinopathies, the evidence that percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) added to therapeutic exercise (TE) is superior to sham or TE alone is of very low certainty—don't count on it. While PNE plus TE *might* offer better short- to medium-term pain reduction than dry needling plus TE, this finding is based on low-certainty evidence.
items.limitation: 该研究的证据确定性较低（very low- to low-certainty），需要更多高质量随机对照试验来明确PNE的临床作用。
items.limitationEn: The study's evidence certainty is low (very low- to low-certainty), and more high-quality RCTs are needed to clarify PNE's clinical role.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Development and validation of a Chinese self-management ability assessment scale for patients with spinal cord injury.
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated a 45-item, 5-dimension self-management ability assessment scale for spinal cord injury (SCI) patients in China. The scale demonstrated acceptable reliability (Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974) and validity, effectively evaluating SCI patients' self-management capacity.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究开发并验证了一款针对脊髓损伤患者的中文自我管理能力评估量表。您可以使用此量表系统评估患者的多维度自我管理能力，从而提供更具针对性的康复支持和教育。
items.titleZh: 中国脊髓损伤患者自我管理能力评估量表的开发与验证
items.summaryZh: 研究人员开发并验证了一款包含5个维度、45个条目的脊髓损伤（SCI）患者自我管理能力评估量表。该量表在中国SCI患者中显示出可接受的信效度（Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974），能有效评估患者的自我管理能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated a Chinese self-management ability assessment scale for patients with spinal cord injury. You can use this scale to systematically assess patients' multidimensional self-management capacities, enabling more targeted rehabilitation support and education.
items.limitation: 该量表是在中国人群中开发和验证的，其在其他文化背景下的适用性仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The scale was developed and validated within a Chinese population, and its applicability in other cultural contexts requires further validation.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study established the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in 216 elite TeamGym gymnasts. Senior males outperformed junior males and all females across hop outcomes, while males completed more heel raises than females (mean difference 4.60, 95% CI 1.91-7.30).
items.curatedReason: 终于有了精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢功能表现的性别和年龄常模，可以直接用来做评估基线了。注意，资深男运动员在跳跃表现上优于青少年男运动员和所有女运动员，男性脚跟抬高次数也比女性多 4.60 次。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究首次建立了216名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模。高级组男性在所有跳跃测试中均优于初级组男性和所有女性，男性完成的提踵次数也多于女性（平均差 4.60, 95% CI 1.91-7.30）。
items.curatedReasonEn: We finally have sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in elite TeamGym gymnasts; use these directly as your assessment baseline. Note that senior males outperformed junior males and all females in hop outcomes, and males completed 4.60 more heel raises than females.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法提供纵向变化趋势或预测损伤风险。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot provide longitudinal trends or predict injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Pain neuroscience in the female athlete
items.summary: This editorial argues for integrating neuronal and nociceptive contributors to pain with mental health, socio-cultural influences, and gynecological health in female athletes. It highlights how the central nervous system translates nociception to pain perception, emphasizing that nociception does not always lead to perceived pain.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论提醒我们，别再孤立看待女性运动员的疼痛，务必将其与心理健康、社会文化因素及妇科健康整合起来。记住，伤害性刺激（nociception）不一定会转化为疼痛感知，中央神经系统的解读才是关键。
items.titleZh: 女性运动员的疼痛神经科学
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论主张将疼痛的神经元和伤害性贡献因素与女性运动员的心理健康、社会文化影响和妇科健康相结合。它强调了中枢神经系统如何将伤害性刺激转化为疼痛感知，并指出伤害性刺激并非总会导致疼痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial is a crucial reminder: stop looking at pain in female athletes in isolation. You must integrate neuronal and nociceptive factors with mental health, socio-cultural influences, and gynecological health. Remember, nociception doesn't always translate to perceived pain; the central nervous system's interpretation is paramount.

items.title: Test-retest reliability of the SCAT6 tandem gait and cognitive components among professional hockey players
items.summary: This study examined the test-retest reliability of SCAT6 tandem gait and cognitive components in professional hockey players. Adequate reliability was found for the tandem gait fastest trial (while wearing skates) and cognitive components, with similar results across English and English as a second language speakers.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 SCAT6 串联步态和认知组件在职业冰球运动员中的重测信度。您在对冰球运动员进行脑震荡评估时，可放心地使用 SCAT6 的串联步态最快试验和认知评分，其结果稳定可靠。
items.titleZh: 职业冰球运动员 SCAT6 串联步态和认知组件的重测信度
items.summaryZh: 本研究检验了 SCAT6 串联步态和认知组件在职业冰球运动员中的重测信度。结果显示，串联步态最快试验（穿着冰鞋时）和认知组件具有足够的信度，且英语和作为第二语言的英语使用者之间结果相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validated the test-retest reliability of SCAT6 tandem gait and cognitive components in professional hockey players. You can confidently use the SCAT6 tandem gait fastest trial and cognitive scores for concussion assessment in hockey players, as the results are stable and reliable.

items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique
items.summary: A systematic review found low certainty evidence that hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis was associated with marginally greater external rotation at 12 weeks, but no significant differences in pain, Shoulder Pain and Disability Index score, shoulder abduction, or forward flexion compared to corticosteroid injection.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，水力扩张术（Hydrodilatation）在冰冻肩治疗中，可能带来短期外旋角度的微小改善，但在疼痛和功能上与皮质类固醇注射无显著差异。这意味着水力扩张术并非颠覆性疗法，其附加价值有限，在与患者讨论治疗方案时，需理性看待。
items.titleZh: 冰冻肩的水力扩张术：探讨疗效和最佳技术的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，针对冰冻肩的水力扩张术在12周时与微小的外旋角度改善相关，但在疼痛、肩关节疼痛与功能障碍指数评分、肩关节外展或前屈方面与皮质类固醇注射无显著差异，且证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis may offer a marginal short-term improvement in external rotation, but no significant differences in pain or function compared to corticosteroid injection. This indicates hydrodilatation is not a game-changer; its added value is limited, and a realistic perspective is needed when discussing treatment options with patients.
items.limitation: 本研究证据确定性较低，且对具体技术因素（如注射量、影像引导）的分析有限，限制了对最佳方案的指导。
items.limitationEn: The study has low certainty of evidence and limited analysis of technical factors (e.g., injection volume, imaging guidance), which restricts guidance on optimal protocols.

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study
items.summary: This longitudinal study examined the association between time-varying social integration and long-term all-cause and cause-specific mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI). It emphasizes that despite advances in acute care and rehabilitation, life expectancy for SCI patients remains shorter, with social and environmental factors playing a significant role in long-term outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）患者长期社会融入程度对全因和特定原因死亡率的影响。这提示您，在制定 SCI 患者的康复计划时，除了传统的功能恢复，还应重视他们的社会参与和生活质量，因为这直接关系到他们的长期生存预后。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后时变社会融入与长期全因和特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向研究探讨了创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）后时变社会融入与长期全因和特定原因死亡率之间的关联。研究强调，尽管急性护理和康复取得了进展，SCI 患者的预期寿命仍低于一般人群，社会和环境因素在长期预后中发挥着重要作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the impact of long-term social integration on all-cause and cause-specific mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI). This suggests that when developing rehabilitation plans for SCI patients, you should prioritize their social participation and quality of life, in addition to traditional functional recovery, as these directly relate to their long-term survival prognosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，虽然显示了相关性，但无法确立社会融入与死亡率之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study, and while it shows correlation, it cannot establish a causal relationship between social integration and mortality.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Injury prediction in sports using artificial intelligence (IPredict-AI) (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD research explored the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning in sports injury prevention, particularly in athletics. It described machine learning approaches, explored perceptions of elite athletes, coaches, and health professionals towards injury prediction, and analyzed the association between self-reported injury risk estimation feedback use and injury burden.
items.curatedReason: 人工智能和机器学习在运动损伤预防中的应用还处于早期阶段。这份博士研究揭示了精英运动员、教练和健康专业人员对损伤预测的看法，虽然有趣，但目前仍是探索性质，别急着引入临床。
items.titleZh: 利用人工智能进行运动损伤预测 (IPredict-AI) (博士学院奖)
items.summaryZh: 这项博士研究探索了人工智能和机器学习在运动损伤预防中的应用，尤其是在田径运动中。它描述了机器学习方法，探讨了精英运动员、教练和健康专业人员对损伤预测的看法，并分析了自我报告的损伤风险评估反馈使用与损伤负担之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: The application of AI and machine learning in sports injury prevention is still in its nascent stages. While this PhD research offers interesting insights into elite athletes', coaches', and health professionals' perceptions of injury prediction, it remains exploratory; don't rush to implement these findings clinically yet.
items.limitation: 该研究主要描述了机器学习方法和相关人员的感知，并非一项干预性研究，无法直接评估 AI 预测模型的实际效果。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily describes machine learning approaches and stakeholders' perceptions, and is not an interventional study, thus cannot directly evaluate the practical effects of AI prediction models.

items.title: Investigating the mental health of elite-level coaches to guide early intervention (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD research investigated the mental health of elite coaches, exploring rates of mental ill-health, risk and protective factors, perceptions, and barriers to help-seeking. It highlights that coaches experience mental ill-health symptoms at similar or higher rates than athletes and that their mental health has been overlooked.
items.curatedReason: 精英教练的心理健康问题长期被忽视，他们出现心理困扰的比例不低于甚至高于运动员。这份研究提醒我们，作为跨学科团队的一员，你需要在支持运动员的同时，也要关注并支持教练的心理健康。
items.titleZh: 调查精英教练的心理健康以指导早期干预 (博士学院奖)
items.summaryZh: 这项博士研究调查了精英教练的心理健康，探究了精神疾病发生率、风险和保护因素、感知以及寻求帮助的障碍。研究强调教练经历精神疾病症状的比例与运动员相似或更高，且他们的心理健康一直被忽视。
items.curatedReasonEn: Elite coaches' mental health has been overlooked; they experience mental ill-health symptoms at rates similar to or even higher than athletes. This research is a call to action: as part of an interdisciplinary team, you must extend your mental health support to coaches, not just athletes.
items.limitation: 本研究侧重于描述教练的心理健康状况、风险和障碍，不涉及具体的干预措施效果评估。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on describing coaches' mental health status, risks, and barriers, and does not involve evaluating the effects of specific interventions.

items.title: Enhancing mountain safety through personalised exercise prescription: the MOVE project (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: The MOVE project developed and validated a personalized digital decision-support system to enhance mountain safety. This tool integrates individual health characteristics with trail-specific demands, providing individualized hiking time estimates, effort quantification, cardiovascular safety thresholds, and tailored recommendations for outdoor physical activity.
items.curatedReason: MOVE 项目开发并验证了一款创新的个性化工具，通过整合个体健康特征和路径需求来支持安全的登山活动。您在为患者提供户外运动建议时，可以关注这类技术进展，以提供更精准的运动处方和风险管理。
items.titleZh: 通过个性化运动处方提升山区安全性：MOVE 项目 (博士学院奖)
items.summaryZh: MOVE 项目开发并验证了一款个性化数字决策支持系统，旨在提升山区安全性。该工具整合了个体健康特征与路径特异性需求，提供个性化的徒步时间估算、运动量量化、心血管安全阈值以及量身定制的户外体育活动建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The MOVE project developed and validated an innovative personalized tool to support safe mountain hiking by integrating individual health characteristics with trail-specific demands. When advising patients on outdoor activities, you can pay attention to such technological advancements to provide more precise exercise prescriptions and risk management.
items.limitation: 该研究主要关注工具的开发和验证，尚未提供大规模临床应用的效果评估或损伤预防的直接证据。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focuses on the development and validation of the tool, and has not yet provided large-scale clinical application effectiveness assessments or direct evidence of injury prevention.

items.title: New Regulations Make It Easier to Find, Compare, and Report Healthcare Pricing and Coverage Information
items.summary: CMS finalized new regulations to strengthen federal healthcare price transparency, requiring group health plans and issuers to provide personalized cost-sharing information by phone and improving the accuracy and accessibility of pricing data, with reporting frequency changing to quarterly.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 发布新规，加强联邦医疗价格透明度要求，旨在让患者更容易查找和比较医疗费用信息。这直接影响医疗机构的收费披露和你的转诊决策，对整个美国医疗系统具有广泛影响。
items.titleZh: 新规使医疗定价和覆盖信息更易查找、比较和报告
items.summaryZh: CMS 最终确定了新的规定，以加强联邦医疗价格透明度，要求团体健康计划和发行方通过电话提供个性化费用分摊信息，并提高定价数据的准确性和可访问性，报告频率改为每季度一次。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has issued new regulations to strengthen federal healthcare price transparency requirements, aiming to make it easier for patients to find and compare healthcare cost information. This directly impacts healthcare providers' pricing disclosures and your referral decisions, having broad implications for the entire U.S. healthcare system.

items.title: Trial holds out promise of life-changing bladder control for paralysed people
items.summary: Interim results from the UK's ImPRESS trial show that an implanted epidural stimulation device significantly improved bladder capacity by an average of 100% and suppressed the urge to urinate in eight spinal cord injury patients.
items.curatedReason: 针对脊髓损伤患者膀胱控制的ImPRESS试验中期结果令人鼓舞，显示硬膜外刺激器结合盆底肌训练可显著改善膀胱容量。这是一项有潜力的技术，但仍处于试验阶段，临床医师应密切关注后续的完整结果。
items.titleZh: 试验为脊髓损伤患者带来膀胱控制的希望
items.summaryZh: 英国ImPRESS试验的中期结果显示，植入式硬膜外刺激装置使8名脊髓损伤患者的膀胱容量平均增加了100%，并抑制了尿意，带来改善膀胱控制的希望。
items.curatedReasonEn: Interim results from the ImPRESS trial for bladder control in spinal cord injury patients are encouraging, showing epidural stimulation combined with pelvic floor muscle training significantly improved bladder capacity. This is a promising technique, but it is still in the trial phase, and clinicians should closely follow the complete results.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - 2026 registration renewal now open
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) announced the opening of 2026 registration renewal for various health professions, including physiotherapists, with a deadline of November 30 to avoid late fees.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者注册局 (AHPRA) 宣布 2026 年执业注册续期开放。这是澳大利亚物理治疗师的强制性年度执业事件，务必在 30 日前完成，以避免滞纳金和执业中断。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者注册局：2026年注册续期现已开放
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者注册局（AHPRA）宣布，包括物理治疗师在内的多个健康专业 2026 年注册续期现已开放，截止日期为 30 日，逾期将产生滞纳金。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has announced the opening of 2026 registration renewals. This is a mandatory annual event for Australian physiotherapists; ensure completion by November 30 to avoid late fees and practice disruption.

items.title: Advocacy by Physical Therapy Students Generates 14,500-plus Letters to Congress
items.summary: The APTA Flash Action Strategy mobilized PT and PTA students to send over 14,500 letters to Congress within two days, advocating for the bipartisan Physical Therapist Workforce and Patient Access Act (H.R. 5621/S. 4420).
items.curatedReason: APTA 闪电行动策略动员学生们向国会提交了超过 14,500 封信函，旨在倡导《物理治疗师劳动力与患者准入法案》。这表明物理治疗学生在推动行业立法方面拥有显著的集体影响力，激励你参与未来的政策倡导。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗学生倡导行动向国会提交逾14,500封信函
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）的闪电行动策略在两天内动员物理治疗师（PT）和物理治疗助理（PTA）学生向国会提交了超过14,500封信函，倡导两党支持的《物理治疗师劳动力与患者准入法案》（H.R. 5621/S. 4420）。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's Flash Action Strategy mobilized students to send over 14,500 letters to Congress, advocating for the Physical Therapist Workforce and Patient Access Act. This demonstrates the significant collective influence of physical therapy students in driving industry legislation, encouraging your participation in future policy advocacy.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Graduates finishing study can apply for registration now
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) encourages graduating health students to apply for registration early to expedite their entry into the workforce, with applications being assessed while awaiting final results.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者注册局 (AHPRA) 建议即将毕业的健康专业学生提前申请注册，以避免延误。这对于澳洲的物理治疗毕业生至关重要，能帮助他们更快地进入职场，确保无缝过渡。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者注册局：毕业生现可申请注册
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者注册局（AHPRA）鼓励即将毕业的健康专业学生尽早申请注册，以便加快进入职场，其申请将在等待最终成绩的同时进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) advises graduating health professional students to apply for registration early to avoid delays. This is crucial for physiotherapy graduates in Australia, enabling them to enter the workforce sooner and ensuring a seamless transition.

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: The "Let's Move" early exercise program for hospitalized patients was developed and piloted, showing a 76.5% adherence rate and 96.2% of participants achieving individualized goals with no adverse events, suggesting feasibility and potential for improving mobility.
items.curatedReason: 这项行动研究设计并试点了一个针对住院患者的早期运动计划，结果显示在提高患者活动能力和依从性方面有初步效果，且安全性良好。临床医师可借鉴其流程，将其纳入常规住院护理，以对抗住院相关失能。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的设计与试点：对抗住院相关失能
items.summaryZh: “Let's Move”早期运动计划针对住院患者设计并试点，依从率为76.5%，96.2%的参与者达到个性化目标，未发生不良事件，提示该计划可行且有改善活动能力的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This action research designed and piloted an early exercise program for hospitalized patients, showing preliminary positive effects on improving patient mobility and adherence with good safety. Clinicians can adapt its workflow into routine inpatient care to combat hospital-associated deconditioning.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的行动研究和试点项目，样本量小（26人），研究设计不具普遍性，需要更广泛的评估来确定其有效性和可扩展性。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary action research and pilot program with a small sample size (26 participants), and its design lacks generalizability, requiring broader evaluation for effectiveness and scalability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Optimal Dextrose Concentration for Prolotherapy in TendinopathyA Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis aims to compare the effectiveness of different dextrose concentrations used in prolotherapy for reducing pain in patients with tendinopathy.
items.curatedReason: 对于肌腱病患者，如果考虑增生疗法，这篇系统综述提供了不同葡萄糖浓度疗效的比较。它提示我们，具体浓度可能比单纯“增生疗法”这一概念更有临床意义，但别忘了关注其较高的异质性。
items.titleZh: 肌腱病增生疗法中葡萄糖最佳浓度：随机对照试验的系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析旨在比较不同浓度葡萄糖增生疗法在减轻肌腱病患者疼痛方面的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're considering prolotherapy for tendinopathy, this systematic review offers a comparison of different dextrose concentrations. It suggests that specific concentrations might be more clinically relevant than just 'prolotherapy' as a concept, but be mindful of the reported high heterogeneity.
items.limitation: 研究未提供具体的效应量和异质性数据，限制了对不同葡萄糖浓度治疗肌腱病疼痛确切疗效的评估。
items.limitationEn: The study does not provide specific effect sizes and heterogeneity data, limiting the precise evaluation of efficacy for different dextrose concentrations in treating tendinopathy pain.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Bracing in adult scoliosis: a scoping review of clinical outcomes
items.summary: A scoping review of 13 studies found that bracing in adults with scoliosis may be associated with improvements in pain and physical function and may contribute to curve stabilization, but the evidence is limited and heterogeneous.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述提示支具对成人脊柱侧弯的疼痛、身体功能和曲度稳定可能有益。在缺乏高质量证据的情况下，可将其作为辅助治疗手段，但切勿视为替代主动康复方案。
items.titleZh: 成人脊柱侧弯支具治疗的临床结局：范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖13项研究的范围综述发现，成人脊柱侧弯支具治疗可能与疼痛和身体功能改善以及曲度稳定有关，但现有证据有限且异质。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that bracing may offer benefits for pain, physical function, and curve stabilization in adults with scoliosis. In the absence of high-quality evidence, consider it an adjunctive treatment, but not a replacement for active rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 纳入的13项研究样本量小、研究设计异质性高且方法学局限，主要为病例报告和观察性研究，限制了证据强度和结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The 13 included studies have small sample sizes, high heterogeneity in study designs, and methodological limitations, primarily being case reports and observational studies, which restrict the strength of evidence and generalizability of conclusions.

items.title:
A commentary on methodological issues in research on rehabilitation needs after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury: lessons learned from quantitative and qualitative studies in Norway
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: This commentary discusses methodological issues in research on rehabilitation needs after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury, drawing lessons from quantitative and qualitative studies in Norway.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评有力地指出，在中重度创伤性损伤后的康复需求研究中，我们必须警惕现有方法学的不足。它强调了混合方法研究的必要性，警示我们在设计相关研究时，仅凭单一方法可能会遗漏关键信息。
items.titleZh: 中重度创伤后康复需求研究方法学问题的评述：挪威定性与定量研究的经验教训
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评讨论了中重度创伤后康复需求研究中的方法学问题，并从挪威的定量和定性研究中汲取经验教训。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary strongly argues that in research on rehabilitation needs after moderate-to-severe traumatic injury, we must be vigilant about methodological shortcomings. It underscores the necessity of mixed-methods studies, warning that relying solely on single methods in designing such research risks missing crucial insights.

items.title: How Will Healthcare Trends Shape Rehab Therapy in 2027—and Beyond?
items.summary: WebPT predicts that in 2027, rehabilitation therapy will face rising payer costs (commercial health plan costs up 9%), increased scrutiny on claims, a push for value-based care, and challenges in patient retention due to inflation impacting practice costs and patient affordability.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 对 2027 年康复治疗行业趋势的分析揭示了支付方成本上升和通货膨胀对诊所运营和患者依从性的影响。这提示你，未来一年的报销环境可能更严峻，需要更注重价值导向的护理和患者留存策略。
items.titleZh: 医疗趋势将如何塑造2027年及以后的康复治疗？
items.summaryZh: WebPT预测2027年康复治疗将面临支付方成本上升（商业健康计划成本上涨9%）、索赔审查更严、价值导向护理推进以及通货膨胀影响诊所成本和患者支付能力导致患者留存挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: WebPT's analysis of 2027 rehab therapy trends reveals how rising payer costs and inflation impact clinic operations and patient adherence. This indicates a potentially tougher reimbursement environment next year, requiring greater focus on value-based care and patient retention strategies.

items.title: Will CMS publish additional guidance on Round 2028 Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program (CBP) licensure requirements? | DCBPS Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program

items.title: Response from Authors to the Letter to the Editor: Interpreting Per-Protocol Efficacy Signals in a Pilot Trial of Inspiratory Muscle Training
items.summary: This response clarifies methodological points regarding a pilot trial on inspiratory muscle training, particularly on the interpretation of per-protocol efficacy signals.
items.curatedReason: 别被这类作者回复带偏了。虽然作者重申 per-protocol 分析对小样本 IMT 试验有其价值，尤其是在评估干预的“真实”效果时，但这毕竟是一个试点研究的回应，我们不能从中得出任何关于 IMT 实际疗效的新结论。
items.titleZh: 作者对编辑信的回应：如何解读吸气肌训练试点试验中的per-protocol疗效信号
items.summaryZh: 这篇作者回复澄清了一项吸气肌训练（IMT）试点试验的方法学观点，特别是关于 per-protocol 疗效信号的解读。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't get sidetracked by author responses like this. While the authors re-affirm the value of per-protocol analysis for small-sample IMT trials, especially in assessing the 'true' intervention effect, this is merely a response to a pilot study. We cannot draw any new conclusions about the actual efficacy of IMT from this.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Do Classical Speed-Accuracy Trade-Off Models Generalize to Lower Limb Movements?
items.summary: This preregistered study aims to investigate whether classical speed-accuracy trade-off models generalize to lower limb stepping movements, hypothesizing deviations from Fitts-type scaling under varying instructional emphasis and postural demands in 24 healthy young adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项预注册研究关注 Fitts 定律在下肢运动中的泛化能力，其结果可能改变我们对平衡和步态训练中速度-准确性权衡的理解，进而优化训练方案。
items.titleZh: 经典的速度-准确性权衡模型能否泛化到下肢运动？
items.summaryZh: 这项预注册研究旨在探讨经典的速度-准确性权衡模型能否泛化到下肢踏步运动，假设在不同教学侧重和姿势需求下，24 名健康年轻人会出现与 Fitts 型缩放的偏差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preregistered study investigates the generalizability of Fitts' law to lower limb movements. Its findings could alter our understanding of speed-accuracy trade-offs in balance and gait training, optimizing intervention protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项预注册研究，尚未发布最终结果，具体结论待定。
items.limitationEn: This is a preregistered study, and the final results are not yet published, so specific conclusions remain to be seen.

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) released a clinical practice guideline using the GRADE approach to inform rehabilitation outcomes in athletes with hamstring strain injury, synthesizing evidence from randomized clinical trials.
items.curatedReason: 这份巴西 SONAFE 发布的临床实践指南，为腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复管理提供了基于 GRADE 证据的明确指导。这是你临床决策的重要依据，尤其在重返运动评估和干预选择上。
items.titleZh: 蕦绳肌拉伤运动员康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南。
items.summaryZh: 巴西运动物理治疗学会 (SONAFE-Brazil) 发布了一项临床实践指南，采用 GRADE 方法，为腘绳肌拉伤运动员的康复结局提供信息，该指南综合了随机临床试验的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline offers clear, GRADE-evidence-based recommendations for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation in athletes. items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: This theoretical paper proposes a framework, HODA-A, for conceptualizing hands-on musculoskeletal examination as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process, aligning with COSMIN principles for construct definition, content validity, examiner calibration, and reliability/validity testing.
items.curatedReason: 本框架将手法评估视为临床报告结果测量工具，而非单纯的技术。这要求我们在评估手法时，需按一套明确的流程来定义、校准、测试可靠性和效度。
items.titleZh: 将肌肉骨骼手法评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术争议：应用 COSMIN 到 HODA-A 的理论框架。
items.summaryZh: 这篇理论文章提出了一个框架 (HODA-A)，将肌肉骨骼手法检查概念化为临床医生报告的结果测量过程，并应用 COSMIN 原则来强调构建定义、内容效度、检查者校准以及可靠性和效度测试的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This framework conceptualizes hands-on assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measure, rather than isolated manual techniques. It highlights the need for a defined sequence of construct definition, calibration, reliability, and validity testing in evaluating manual therapy.
items.limitation: 本研究为理论框架，尚未进行实证验证。
items.limitationEn: This study proposes a theoretical framework and lacks empirical validation.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: In a 30-patient RCT, thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF) and inspiratory muscle strength (MIP) in chronic stroke patients, with greater changes in the KT group (all p < 0.001) compared to sham taping.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴布（KT）联合常规康复能显著改善慢性卒中患者的肺功能和吸气肌力量，其作用主要通过优化通气力学而非直接肌肉强化实现。可考虑作为神经康复中的实用辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴布对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力量及功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 30 名患者的随机对照试验显示，胸部肌内效贴布（KT）结合常规康复治疗能显著改善慢性卒中患者的肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF）和吸气肌力量（MIP），与假贴布组相比，KT 组的变化更为显著（所有 p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function and inspiratory muscle strength in chronic stroke patients, primarily by optimizing ventilatory mechanics. This suggests it can be a practical adjunct in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=30），随访期短。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (N=30) and a short follow-up period.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An 81-patient RCT showed that both kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise effectively reduced pain, disability, and headache frequency in cervicogenic headache over 4 weeks. MFR provided more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life (p < 0.001) at one-month follow-up compared to KT.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴布（KT）和筋膜松弛术（MFR）联合家庭锻炼，对颈源性头痛患者的短期止痛和改善头痛频率均有效，且 MFR 在改善残疾和身体生活质量方面可能提供更持久的益处。这意味着你可以自信地将两者纳入颈源性头痛的多模式康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布与筋膜松弛疗法治疗颈源性头痛的比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项 81 名患者的随机对照试验显示，肌内效贴布（KT）和筋膜松弛术（MFR）结合家庭锻炼，在 4 周内均有效减轻了颈源性头痛患者的疼痛、残疾和头痛频率。与 KT 相比，MFR 在一个月随访时在残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善（p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR), combined with home exercise, are effective for short-term pain relief and headache frequency reduction in cervicogenic headache patients. MFR may offer more sustained benefits for disability and physical quality of life, supporting their confident integration into multimodal rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究随访期较短（1 个月），长期效果仍需更多证据。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period (1 month), and long-term effects require further evidence.
